programme.desc: Bli med inn hvis du tør. På dagtid besøker vi ekstremsamlere og spøkelsesjegere, mens vi om natten skrur opp stemningen med skrekkfilmer og går inn i de mest skremmende hjemsøkte husene.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tiffany, Tony Plana, Morgan Brittany
programme.desc: An angry teenage Tiffany reads the Satanic bible and unleashes evil from the other side. Tony Plana encounters a cannibalistic entity that leaves him fearing for his life.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tito Ortiz, Cary Elwes. Sally Kellerman, Drake Bell
programme.desc: One of the toughest men in the world, Tito Ortiz, encounters a spirits that terrifies him and his girlfriend. Cary Elwes has a brush with a bone chilling skeletal ghost.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskepikker
programme.desc: Jimmi er rasende for at Cartmann prøver å ta æren for en vits som han fant på og som nå er blitt populær i hele landet. Men en sint Kanye West klarer ikke å forstå poenget.

programme.desc: Michael Jacksons spøkelse nekter å akseptere å måtte vandre heden og etterlater resten av de nylig avdøde berømtheter frustrert i Skjærsilden.

programme.title: South Park: Sexhjelpen
programme.desc: Kyle og Butters befinner seg midt blant Amerikas superkjendiser når de gjennomgår en behandling for sexavhengighet. Cartman og Stan er limt til Tiger Woods-kampen.

programme.title: South Park: Lattermaskinen
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt gjort narr av på The South Park Elementary Comedy Awards, bygger Germany en uovervinnerlig lattermaskin: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheten går likevel ikke altfor bra.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman finner kjærligheten
programme.desc: Cartman spiller matchmaker når en ny jente flytter til South Park.

programme.desc: Cartman innrømmer endelig at han er feit og får umiddelbart en permobil.

programme.title: South Park: Hobbiten
programme.desc: Wendy prøver å pare en av sine venninner med Butters, men hun ender opp på kontoret til skolekuratoren.

programme.desc: Kyle vil bare spille tv-spill med lillebroren sin. Men da Ike vil ikke spille med ham mer, blir Kyle redd for at neste generasjon vil forbigå ham.

programme.desc: Cartman trender, mens resten av USA forbereder seg til det største juleprogrammet på tv noensinne.

programme.title: Aeon Flux

programme.title: My Haunted House: Unwanted Guest and Mirror Image
programme.desc: A dangerous poltergeist threatens a newly-blended family. A young woman is tormented by visions of her own gruesome death.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Trapped and Retreat
programme.desc: Paranormal activity threatens a young nurse caring for a catatonic patient. A young couple falls prey to a demonic presence in a remote cabin.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Vow of Silence and Cryptic
programme.desc: A single mother's new home was once a convent that kept a horrifying secret. A couple is tormented by the meaning of a date that keeps appearing in their new home.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Johnathan Schaech
programme.desc: Actor Johnathon Schaech (That Thing You Do!, Texas Rising) anxiously returns to an old theater in Austin, Texas where he had a harrowing and life-changing paranormal experience. With psychic medium Kim Russo by his side.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Carole Radziwill
programme.desc: Author, journalist and Real Housewife Carole Radziwill returns to the Hamptons, New York beach home where she once encountered a ghostly presence.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Cartman retar de andra för att de inte har en iPad, fast han inte har nån själv och Kyle accepterar ett användaravtal utan att läsa det - varpå mystiska agenter tvingar honom att gå med på saker han skrivit på att han accepterar.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet II
programme.desc: Regeringen håller Stan och Kyle fångna och tänker inte släppa dem förrän de avslöjar hur de tog sig in i Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan och Butters är fast i Imaginationland och måste slåss för sina liv mot en ondskefull armé. Kyle och Cartman är fortfarande i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: Kiss
programme.desc: En rolig dag i vattenparken blir plötsligt livshotande.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet I
programme.desc: Pojkarna hamnar i ett magiskt land där de får chansen att köpa hela världens fantasi. Men en terroristkomplott hotar att förstöra affären.

programme.title: South Park: Valhoror
programme.desc: Stan försöker att stoppa japanerna från att döda alla valar och delfiner i världen.

programme.title: South Park: Crackbabyförbundet
programme.desc: När Kyle upptäcker att Cartman arbetar frivilligt med crackbebisar på sjukhuset blir han misstänksam. Och vad har Slash från Guns N' Roses med detta att göra?

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren
programme.desc: Cartman tror att han vet vem som var hjärnan bakom 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: En miljon små fibrer
programme.desc: Towelie skriver en bok och den väljs ut till Oprahs bokklubb. Den blir en bästsäljare för människor som vill bli fria från sina beroenden.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet med tvåan i pissoaren
programme.desc: Cartman tror att han vet vem som var hjärnan bakom 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Momben
programme.desc: South Parks invånare gör sig redo för Hillary Clintons besök. Cartman misstänker att en ny muslimsk elev är inblandad i en eventuell terroristattack.

programme.title: South Park: Mer skitproblem
programme.desc: Randy bryter rekordet för 'världens största bajskorv'. Bono, den förra rekordhållaren, är fast besluten att återta sin krona. Men han har en mörk hemlighet som kan stoppa honom.

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nya look
programme.desc: Mediecirkusen anländer till South Park när Britney gömmer sig i den avlägsna bergsstaden. Pojkarna försöker hjälpa den deprimerade popstjärnan.

programme.title: South Park: Kinaproblemet
programme.desc: Cartman blir förskräck när han ser hur storslagen OS-invigningen är. Han anlitar Butters för att hjälpa honom att konfrontera kineserna. Samtidigt bevittnar Stan och Kyle Indiana Jones 'våldtäkt'.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med sin nya tjej på en konsert med Jonas Brothers där de köper var sin kyskhetsring.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskpittar
programme.desc: Cartman och Jimmy kommer på det roligaste skämtet någonsin.

programme.title: South Park: Döda kändisar
programme.desc: Ike plågas av övernaturliga krafter, så Kyle anlitar professionella spökjägare för att rädda sin lillebror.

programme.title: South Park: Chefhjälpen
programme.desc: Chef försöker göra anspråk på royalties från ett skivbolag när de släpper en låt som han påstår att han skrev för 20 år sedan.

programme.title: South Park: Regnskog bängskog
programme.desc: Pojkarna skickas till Costa Ricas regnskog som en del av kören Getting Gay With Kids turné.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman och Kenny är fast i den senaste trenden från Japan, en tecknad serie som heter Chinpokomon - men vad är den hemliga planen bakom programmets antiamerikanska motiv?

programme.title: South Park: Världens största blockflöjtskonsert
programme.desc: Klassen besöker Mr Garrisons hemstad i Arkansas för att gå på en konsert där de försöker hitta det mystiska "bruna ljudet".

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Pojkarna härmar Timmy, som har ADD, för att slippa göra sina läxor.

programme.title: South Park: Nåt du kan göra med fingret
programme.desc: 'Fingerbang' är det senaste pojkbandet med de fyra pojkarna och de får en spelning i ett stort shoppingcenter.

programme.title: South Park: Musikalen Helen Keller!
programme.desc: Pojkarna skapar en egen version av berättelsen om Helen Keller för att överglänsa dagisets uppsättning.

programme.title: South Park: En stege till himlen
programme.desc: Pojkarna bryter in i McCormicks hus och stjäl urnan med Kennys aska.

programme.title: South Park: Fetröv och pannkakshuvud
programme.desc: Cartman gör en fingerdocka som liknar J-Lo inför ett multikulturellt evenemang som hyllar latinamerikaner.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Under en resa börjar Brad fundera på ungdomsvännernas rika och glamorösa tillvaro. Hans bekväma och trevliga medelklassliv bleknar i jämförelse. Besvikelsen tar överhanden och han börjar ifrågasätta hur bra hans liv egentligen är.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Donald bor sedan 17 år i ett självbyggt kyffe i parken Hampstead Heath i London. När det ska byggas lyxbostäder där han bor vägrar han att flytta. Han får då oväntad hjälp av den amerikanska änkan Emily och en djup vänskap uppstår mellan dem.

programme.title: Sångklubben
programme.desc: Kvinnorna på en militärbas i England försöker styra sinnet från sina bekymmer och tanken på en kör tar form. Men ingen av dem hade förväntat sig att uppträda i Royal Albert Hall...

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen medverkar i denna gripande och roliga berättelse om en pappa med en annorlunda inställning till föräldraskapet som blir tvungen att visa den moderna världen för barnen.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: Cassiel är en ängel som vakar över människorna i det återförenade Berlin. Trots att änglarna egentligen inte får ingripa i människornas liv rycker Cassiel in för att rädda en liten flicka som faller ned från en balkong.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Etsad i sten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Stewie Harper åker till Stockholm i Sverige för att hitta runstenen från kung Jann I av Norge.

programme.title: Andromeda: En ros i askan
programme.desc: Dylan är fängslad på en fängelseplanet och måste planera en flykt när hans besättning försöker göra sin egen räddning.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det stora Neptunus hav
programme.desc: Castalianer går ombord på Andromeda för att slutföra stadgan för det Nya Samväldet. När ledaren upptäcks död är Tyr den huvudmisstänkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Pärlorna som var hans ögon
programme.desc: Beka får reda på att hennes fars tidigare affärspartner säljer en starkt beroendeframkallande drog som kallas Flash.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårarnas matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda upptäcker sitt systerskepp Pax Magellanic. Besättningen ombord på Pax är 300 år gammal... men har inte åldrats en dag.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programme.desc: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: It's a Good Life
programme.desc: Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2

programme.title: South Park: Döda kändisar

programme.title: South Park: Zimmermans världskrig

programme.desc: Efter att pojkarna köpt kampsportsvapen på en lokal loppmarknad förvandlas de till animerade japanska krigare vilket får förödande konsekvenser för Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Dö, hippie, dö
programme.desc: Cartman arresteras för att fängsla hippies, men när South Park översvämmas av hippies vänder sig staden till honom och han oortodoxa metoder för att bli av med hippiesarna.

programme.title: South Park: Agenturen
programme.desc: Som talangmanager kan Cartman, Stan och Kenny ta 10 % av sina kunders förtjänster. Men efter att de idogt har försökt att imponera på sin enda kund stjäls han av en annan manager.

programme.title: South Park: Mer skitproblem
programme.desc: Randy bryter rekordet för 'världens största bajskorv'. Bono, den förra rekordhållaren, är fast besluten att återta sin krona. Men han har en mörk hemlighet som kan stoppa honom.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Stan och Kyle är beredda att ta sig upp i världen med sina färdigheter i datorspelet Guitar Hero. Deras manager övertygar Stan att Kyle håller honom tillbaka vilket orsakar spänning.

programme.title: South Park: Hög skolmusikal!
programme.desc: När den sjungande, dansande musikalfebern kommer till South Park måste pojkarna spela med eller ge upp sin popularitet.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tar med sin nya tjej på en konsert med Jonas Brothers där de köper var sin kyskhetsring.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskpittar
programme.desc: Cartman och Jimmy kommer på det roligaste skämtet någonsin.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead
programme.desc: Donald bor sedan 17 år i ett självbyggt kyffe i parken Hampstead Heath i London. När det ska byggas lyxbostäder där han bor vägrar han att flytta. Han får då oväntad hjälp av den amerikanska änkan Emily och en djup vänskap uppstår mellan dem.

programme.title: Mustang
programme.desc: Vad fem tonårssystrar ser som en oskyldig lek med några killar tolkas av andra i byn som osedlighet. Historien växer till oanade proportioner och snart börjar systrarnas frihet kringskäras allt mer. Men upproret bubblar under ytan hos systerskaran.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Unlawful Flight
programme.desc: In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Secrets
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i Endora, med sin autistiska lillebror Arnie och sin rörelsehindrade mamma, ger det honom lite tid för ett eget liv. Så en dag kommer Becky till Endora och det uppstår en alldeles speciell vänskap mellan henne och Gilbert.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Efter terrorattackerna den 11 september utser kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg till att leda kompensationsfonden för offren. Feinberg står nu inför en omöjlig uppgift - att avgöra vad ett liv är värt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: 1968 anländer Judy Garland till London för en rad utsålda konserter. Utåt charmar Judy alla med sin värme och karisma, men inuti är hon djupt ärrad av ett liv i rampljuset och en tuff vårdnadstvist.

programme.title: Pretty Baby
programme.desc: A photographer in turn-of-the-century New Orleans takes pictures of prostitutes, and eventually falls for one hooker's prepubescent daughter. A memorable film debut for Shields at 12.

programme.title: Trinity klipper till igen
programme.desc: Västerns värsta vildhjärnor rider tillsammans igen och då blir västern verkligen vild. De är bröderna som din mamma varnade dig för. Och din doktor! Och alla begravningsbyråer! Och framförallt läkarna som måste ta hand om alla som skrattat käkarna ur led!

programme.title: Mutant X: Dödlig längtan
programme.desc: Teamet försöker hindra Eckhart från att skaffa ett sällsynt ämne, men en tjuv tar det. Kvinnan som har förmågan att få män att bli förälskade i henne riktar sina ögon mot Brennan.

programme.title: Mutant X: En ras från varandra
programme.desc: Mutant X möter en ny grupp nya mutanter som kallas Strand och leds av den mäktiga första mutanten Gabriel Ashlocke.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dans på rakhyveln
programme.desc: När Mutant X och Genomex fångas på film när de använder sina krafter måste de båda ta itu med reportern som planerar att publicera informationen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Det förflutna som en prolog
programme.desc: I ett desperat försök att rädda sitt eget liv återupplivar Ashlocke en gammal egyptisk alkemist som utgör ett dödligt hot mot Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kärlekens bok
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Milano i Italien för att leta efter Casanovas försvunna Kärleksbok.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Tis Time to Smell the Roses
programme.desc: Al plans on retiring early, but Peggy spends too much money shopping and he must get a job at Homeplate Athletic Shoes.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Old Insurance Dodge
programme.desc: Al tries to scam the insurance company when the Dodge is stolen.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Wedding Repercussions
programme.desc: Bud's cousin shows up angry after finding out that someone slept with his wife before their wedding...not knowing that that person is Bud.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Proposition
programme.desc: Al's old girlfriend wants to buy Al from Peggy for $500,000.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: A Tisket, a Tasket, Can Peg Make a Basket?
programme.desc: When Al and Peggy go to a basketball game, Peggy switches seats with Al and her seat is chosen for a $10,000 free throw contest.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Hood 'n the Boyz
programme.desc: Al helps his childhood girlfriend deal with a young tough guy and his gang.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Proud to Be Your Bud?
programme.desc: The family thinks Bud is insane when they overhear him talking to himself in his room.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Luck of the Bundys
programme.desc: When the Bundys start having good luck, Al remembers the Bundy Curse and realizes he is doomed.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Banking on Marcy
programme.desc: Marcy tries to imagine being in the bedroom to improve her ability to speak in front of large audiences, but her fantasies tend to go a little too wild.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Scared Straight / Citizen Butt-head Part 2
programme.desc: To teach them that crime doesn't pay, Beavis & Butt-head's principal sends them to prison for a day. Bad idea. / Beavis & Butt-head and President Clinton explore chaos theory together.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Murder Site / Sexual Harassment
programme.desc: Beavis can't take Butt-head's verbal abuse anymore, and snaps while they're checking out the site of a local murder. / Beavis and Butt-head sue Kimberly for sexual harassment, since she's giving them wood.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Take a number / Stewart moves away / Premature evacuation
programme.desc: The duo goes to rock concert / Beavis and Butt-Head breaks into Stewarts house to watch TV / A bomb threat is called into their high school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Butt-Head blir snäll / Hemhjälpen
programme.desc: Butt-Head får medicin för sin aggressivitet mot Beavis och blir lite för snäll./ Medelålders Beavis och Butt-Head får slut på ölpengar, så Beavis måste skaffa ett jobb.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Radio Sweethearts / The Great Cornholio
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head win a radio contest and become disc jockeys for a day. / During a sugar rush, Beavis' alter ego appears. He reeks havoc at Highland High looking for "teepee for his bunghole."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Execution Tickets
programme.desc: The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine's Pregnant
programme.desc: A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jones Gets Suspended
programme.desc: Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Help From the FBI
programme.desc: While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel Suicide Watch
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine Gets Married
programme.desc: Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Anniversary
programme.desc: The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Moving Day
programme.desc: Dangle needs help moving out of his house, and Junior teaches Reno's youth about prison life.

programme.title: Rough Stuff
programme.desc: En grupp miljöaktivister som gör en film för att avslöja ett stort gruvbolags skumraskaffärer anlitar ett gäng skattletande strövare – laglösa människor som bor ute i den australiska vildmarken.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: I denna actionfyllda sci-fi-thriller besöker en grupp unga amerikaner Moskva när en främmande art invaderar en stad och kastar dem mitt i en desperat kamp för överlevnad.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemin II: Marsvinigt
programme.desc: Enorma marsvin anfaller städer runt om i världen. Pojkarna har nyckeln som kan rädda mänskligheten, men de sitter fast i Anderna.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reser sig
programme.desc: Mysterions hemliga identitet avslöjas. Samtidigt hånas Coon av sina Superhjältar och vill utkräva hämnd.

programme.title: South Park: Coon mot Coon och vänner
programme.desc: Coon och vänner är utlämnade till Cartmans nycker, eftersom han nu har mörkrets härskare Cthulhu i sin makt. Kenny kämpar mot sin superkrafts förbannelse i form av sitt alter ego.

programme.title: South Park: Den fattigaste
programme.desc: Kennys föräldrar grips av polisen och han hamnar i ett fosterhem - vilket gör Cartman till skolans fattigaste elev! Samtidigt återvänder en mystisk maskerad superhjälte från det förflutna.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julbajskorven
programme.desc: Borgmästaren bestämmer sig för att införa ett oförargligt helgtema som inte väcker anstöt hos någon. Kyle tror att han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Läskiga fisken
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs moster Flo har presenter till Shelly och Stan. Shelly får en fantastiskt stereo medan Stans present är en fisk som ser ganska läskig ut.

programme.title: South Park: Succuban
programme.desc: Cartman besöker optikern, en man som gör sig lustig över Cartmans viktproblem genom att kalla honom 'Piggy'.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman och Kenny är fast i den senaste trenden från Japan, en tecknad serie som heter Chinpokomon - men vad är den hemliga planen bakom programmets antiamerikanska motiv?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: For nearly 200 years, the Jailer’s Inn housed prisoners, many of whom were involved in the city’s bustling Bourbon trade. The Team visits with the Inn’s manager to learn about notable inmates like Jesse James.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: South Park: Ikes pillesnopp
programme.desc: Kyle försöker rädda sin lillebrors penis från att skäras av.

programme.title: South Park: Väsendet
programme.desc: Kyles kusin, Kyle Schwartz, från Connecticut flyttar till South Park på grund av hans mammas sviktande hälsa. Kyle tycker först att det är roligt men det tar inte lång tid innan 'Kyle 2' börjar gå honom på nerverna.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrisons nya vackra vagina
programme.desc: Mr Garrison får äntligen sitt sexbyte och Kyle är med om en tämligen ovanligt operation som gör honom tillräckligt lång och muskulös för att klara uttagningen till basketbollaget.

programme.title: South Park: Passa er för de självgoda!
programme.desc: South Parks invånare köper hybridbilar. Men precis när det börjar känna sig riktigt nöjda med sin miljövänlighet samlas ett mörkt moln över staden.

programme.title: South Park: Det är en Jersey-grej

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Cartman retar de andra för att de inte har en iPad, fast han inte har nån själv och Kyle accepterar ett användaravtal utan att läsa det - varpå mystiska agenter tvingar honom att gå med på saker han skrivit på att han accepterar.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet II
programme.desc: Regeringen håller Stan och Kyle fångna och tänker inte släppa dem förrän de avslöjar hur de tog sig in i Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasilandet III
programme.desc: Stan och Butters är fast i Imaginationland och måste slåss för sina liv mot en ondskefull armé. Kyle och Cartman är fortfarande i Pentagon.

programme.title: South Park: Kiss
programme.desc: En rolig dag i vattenparken blir plötsligt livshotande.

programme.title: South Park: Trygg plats

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Klassens nya kille övertalar Jesus att kämpa för hans far, Satan, i den slutliga kampen om mellan godheten och ondskan. Cartman blir upprörd när han hör att dusten är på samman dag som hans födelsedagskalas.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman och Kyle blir osams om en magisk triangel de hittar under en arkeologisk utgrävning. Triangeln har kraften att omvandla Barbra Streisand till ett otäckt monster.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans morsa är en slampa
programme.desc: Dr Mephisto hjälper Cartman att gräva fram sanningen om hans pappas identitet. Strålkastarljuset skiner på ett antal invånare i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Staden vid avgrundens rand (återblickar)
programme.desc: Skolbussen hamnar på kanten av en ravin efter en snöstorm.

programme.title: South Park: Chefhjälpen
programme.desc: Chef försöker göra anspråk på royalties från ett skivbolag när de släpper en låt som han påstår att han skrev för 20 år sedan.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpoko Mon
programme.desc: Stan, Cartman och Kenny är fast i den senaste trenden från Japan, en tecknad serie som heter Chinpokomon - men vad är den hemliga planen bakom programmets antiamerikanska motiv?

programme.title: South Park: Tamponger av Cherokeehår
programme.desc: Kyle behöver en njurtransplantation och Cartman är en perfekt donator, men Cartman sätter ett högt pris på sin njure: 10 miljoner dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman måste dö
programme.desc: Cartman blir ursinnig på Scott Tenorman när rödhårige Scott lurar vår medgörlige hjälte att köpa hans pubeshår för 6,12 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Kiss
programme.desc: En rolig dag i vattenparken blir plötsligt livshotande.

programme.title: South Park: Broadwaybröderna
programme.desc: När Randy får veta hemligheten om varför musikaler är så populära kan han inte sluta att ta med Sharon för att se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber och Elton John varnar honom för att avslöja deras hemlighet.

programme.title: South Park: Butters ger igen
programme.desc: Butters mobbas i hemlighet av sin farmor och Stan försöker att uppmärksamma folk om faran med mobbning. Han gör en dansvideo, men framgången stiger honom åt huvudet. Stan misslyckas och åker till San Diego för att näcka i ett gathörn.

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfri ebola
programme.desc: South Park blir glutenfritt.

programme.title: South Park: Pre-CIS
programme.desc: Enligt Eric Cartman har Wendy Testaburger blivit lesbisk.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper inte
programme.desc: Cartman anser sig vara South Parks viktigaste matkritiker på nätet.

programme.title: South Park: Lägg ifrån dig den
programme.desc: Nordkorea ställer in siktet på South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Hummelfigurer & Heroin
programme.desc: Flera älskade underhållare går ur tiden efter att ha överdoserat på opiater, och Stan är på vippen att avslöjas som källan till dessa olagliga droger.

programme.title: South Park: Dubbeltrubbel i Kina
programme.desc: Randy ser en möjlighet för Tegridy i Kina.

programme.title: Bageriet på Portobello Road
programme.desc: Tre generationer kvinnor som måste övervinna sorg, tvivel och hur de ska hedra deras älskade Sarahs minne samtidigt som de börjar ett äventyr att etablera ett bageri mitt i London som är fylld av kärlek, hopp och färgstarka bakverk från hela världen.

programme.title: From Time to Time
programme.desc: En spökhistoria som spänner över två världar med mer än ett sekel från varandra. När 13-åriga Tolly upptäcker att han på ett mystiskt sätt kan resa mellan de två, börjar han ett äventyr som avslöjar familjehemligheter som har begravts i generationer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: Ghost Town är en andlig, romantisk komedi som handlar om Bertram Pincus, en sur tandläkare på Manhattan som får den obehagliga förmågan att se döda människor.

programme.title: Teaaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: Leigh Anns (Katie Holmes) drömmar om ett stipendium saboteras när hennes lärare, mrs Tingle, anklagar henne för att ha fuskat. I ett desperat försök att bevisa sin oskuld, konspirerar Leigh Ann för att lära mrs Tingle en läxa.

programme.title: Win A Date With Tad Hamilton!
programme.desc: Rosalee är en idolfixerad småstadsflicka vars dröm blir sann när hon vinner en dejt med Tad Hamilton. Och även om hennes drömmar förverkligas, betyder detta rent kaos för hennes bäste vän.

programme.title: Beautiful Boy
programme.desc: Den framgångsrike journalisten David har alltid försökt ge sin älskade son allt han behöver. Men vare sig David eller Nics mamma Vicki kan hindra sonen från att börja experimentera med crystal meth.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Ett kapat flygplan kommer att krascha om bara 97 minuter när bränslet tar slut. NSA-chefen vill att planet ska skjutas ner innan dess och lämnar de oskyldiga passagerarnas öde i händerna på en hemlig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Ruskiga Rekryter - In war with the army
programme.desc: Alvin (Jerry Lewis) och Vic (Dean Martin) är kompisar som söker värvning i armén, främst därför att Vic har problem med sin flickvän och söker sig via det militära till en tjänstgöring i Europa.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Myten om labyrinten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel och Claudia besöker Aten i Grekland för att leta i Minotaurus labyrint efter den legendariska gyllene tråden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kejsarens brud
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Moose Bay i Alaska och letar efter en kinesisk kejsarinnas sarkofag av vit jade. Sydney stöter på sina kolleger Dallas Carter och Kurt Reiner, som också är relikjägare.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Efterliv och döden
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel är i Kairo, Egypten och sedan i Amsterdam. De måste besegra den rivaliserande relikjägaren Avery Ko till farao Thutmoses diamant innan den skärs upp och säljs.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musik från en avlägsen trumma
programme.desc: Tyr kraschlandar Eureka Maru på en Nietzscheansk planet och får minnesförlust. Han måste komma ihåg vad han gör innan nietzscheanerna upptäcker honom och hans låda med stöldgods.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper får kunskapens gåva från en döende perseid, men upptäcker att perseiden var eftersökt av en prisjägare som nu har riktat sin uppmärksamhet mot Harper.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: Nocturnal Animals
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.desc: Freddy Krueger is getting married and just wants an answer to one simple question: Who is his father? The RC team shows what it's like being the daughter of a plastic Army Man. The Totally Spies girls learn international law...and get PTSD.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Boogie Bardstown in: No Need, I have Coupons
programme.desc: The RC creators imagine what would have happened if Stretch Armstrong had lived during Medieval times. The G.I. Joe team realizes that solving real world problems aren't so easy. Gordon Ramsey gets some pretty impressive celebrity chef's.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Snoopy Camino Lindo in: Quick and Dirty Squirrel Shot
programme.desc: The Scooby Gang saves Velma's from getting cancer. We see what really happened on board Noah's ark. The Robot Chicken Writers wonder what happens to all the toys that have ever been recalled.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Molly Lucero in: Your Friend's Boob
programme.desc: Betty Spaghetty tries her best to save an elevator full of people. RC finds out what goes on behind Bert and Ernie's closed bedroom doors. Godzilla: The Musical comes to a Broadway theatre and brings the house down.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Spike Fraser in: Should I Happen to Back into a Horse
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken crew reveals what really happened to Bambi's mother. An Animorph revives the Red Panda population. See what happens after Brainy Smurf gets diagnosed with CTE. And Bitch Pudding goes up against Norman Bates.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Squatch Squad emerges from hiding to protect their forest home. The Wuzzles meet The Fly and things get a little bit crazy. The RC writers show us Bill & Ted's last and greatest adventure.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken's Santa's Dead (Spoiler Alert) Holiday Murder Thing Special
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken Christmas Murder Mystery Special!

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Callie Greenhouse in: Fun. Sad. Epic. Tragic.
programme.desc: Batman makes an addition to his costume. Ride along with the Westeros, P.D. and see how they solve crimes. And the RC crew puts Bitch Pudding on Love Island to see what kind of match she will find.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Max Caenen in: Why Would He Know If His Mother's A Size Queen
programme.desc: The Lady of the Lake gives Percival some trouble. The Robot Chicken crew shows what Dumbledore sees in the Mirror of Desire. Professor X reveals how the X-Men first discovered their powers. And Garfield gets buried in the pet cemetery.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Petless M in: Cars are Couches of the Road
programme.desc: The RC writers imagine Harry Potter as a 70's sitcom. The future looks bleak for Nostradamus's assistant. We answer the question of what's underneath Abe Lincoln's hat. And the Jonas Brothers learn they are more than just brothers.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Buster Olive in: The Monkey Got Closer Overnight
programme.desc: Tyrion Lannister learns the true meaning of "winter is coming." Blade tries to slice his way into infomercials. Inside Out Boy goes to college. The Robot Chicken writers show what happens when Halloween meets Home Alone.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Ghandi Mulholland in: Plastic Doesn't Get Cancer
programme.desc: Good Will Hunting goes Goodwill Hunting. Pennywise the clown shows off some new moves. A Fortnite contractor is hired to build a house. And the RC crew reimagines the show Pete & Pete.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Gracie Purgatory in: That's How You Get Hemorrhoids
programme.desc: We learn what Squidward is up to after his role on Spongebob ends. Uber has a new ride share system. Broadway will never be the same after Venom joins the cast of Hamilton. Pink Panther challenges The Black Panther for the throne.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Sundancer Craig in: 30% of the Way to Crying
programme.desc: Rita Repulsa finally figures out a way to take down The Power Rangers. We get to see Freddy Krueger's worst nightmare. The Robot Chicken crew reveals the monster from Bird Box. We get to see a different viewpoint from the movie Predator.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Babe Hollytree in: I Wish One Person Had Died
programme.desc: The Pomsie's have come to take over our world! The kids at Hogwarts get to see each others' true fears. The RC gang puts a new twist on Old Yeller. We learn that Alexa never stops listening and that can only lead to one thing...

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Super, Extra-Special, One of a Kind, 200th episode spectacular! The Robot Chicken crew finally reveals everything you wanted to know about his experiment with the chicken, the chair, and the televisions.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Emperor gets an upsetting phone call. George Lucas is saved from a mob of nerds by one helpful fan. Imperial officers learn how to survive Darth Vader in Orientation. A commercial for Admiral Ackbar Cereal. Boba Fett has a little fun with Han in Carbonite. The truth about Ponda Baba's bad day. President Bush is strong with the force in George of the Jedi. Luke and the Emperor settle things with a "yo mama" fight. Max Rebo's Greatest Hits goes on sale. Jar Jar and Anakin are together again

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode II
programme.desc: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode II parodies many of the beloved Star Wars characters from the first special, while adding additional fan favorites: Bossk, IG-88, Zuckus, 4-LOM, Dengar and others as they set off on their quest to capture Han Solo. We reunite with Emperor Palpatine as he gets the idea to place an ad for Bounty Hunters from his hairdresser and spend a day with Gary, the Stormtrooper, who has to suffer through Bring Your Daughter to Work Day.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken: Star Wars Episode III
programme.desc: The Emmy Award-winning Robot Chicken returns with its third send-up of the Star Wars universe! In this all-new hour-long special, four very different characters -- Emperor Palpatine, Darth Vader, Boba Fett and Gary the Stormtrooper -- reveal untold stories that weave and interconnect throughout all six Star Wars films! Set phasers to "fun"! Oh wait, that's the wrong franchise.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken Nerd, the Humping Robot, Composite Santa, and the Mad Scientist join characters of the DC Comics universe to poke fun at those with the most impressive powers and the lesser ones who can't really be called superheroes.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken: DC Comics Special II: Villains in Paradise

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken DC Comics Special III: Magical Friendship
programme.desc: The Robot Chicken writers don their capes and masks one more time for this epic special! Batman and Superman's bromance takes a competitive turn and the fate of the universe somehow hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.sub-title: Robot Chicken Walking Dead Special: Look Who's Walking, The

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Rachael Leigh Cook smashes more than eggs in her latest anti-heroin public service announcement. Optimus Prime, leader of the Transformers, falls prey to prostate cancer. The outcome is never in doubt during "World's Most One-Sided Fistfights Caught on Film." Outtakes from Dukes of Hazzard, The X-Files, Battlestar Galactica and more come to light in "Bloopers."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Voltron engages in an old-school dance-off in "You Got Robo-Served." The secret lives of nature's most fascinating beasts are exposed in "Secrets of the Animal Kingdom." Testicles are terrorized in "Ode to the Nut Shot."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The animals Noah left behind try to survive the flood in their very own ark. Enjoy instant nostalgia with "That '00s Show." Mrs. McNally's third-graders produce an animated abomination in "The Best Cowboy." The world's most famous cars--from KITT to the Batmobile to the General Lee--race against each other in "3 Fast 3 Furious."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The tooth fairy stumbles into murder in "Tooth and Consequences." The world's most terrifying supervillains get stuck in traffic. More of television's greatest screw-ups, from Friends to Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood to Saved by the Bell, are highlighted in "Bloopers Two."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The secrets of The Crying Game, Star Wars and The Village are exposed in "Welcome to the Spoilers." The Teen Titans strengthen their roster by adding Beavis and Butt-head. Travel back in time to witness Benny Hill's funeral. The Great Pumpkin of Peanuts fame finally shows itself--and starts killing everyone in sight.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: A teenage girl gets a fashion makeover in "Pimp My Sister." The Surreal Life gang gets sent on mission to destroy an enchanted ring. Debbie Does Dallas gets re-told with the world's cheapest puppets in "Exhausted Budget Theater." Geeks and nerds collide when a sci-fi convention erupts into war.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Seven of the world's greatest heroes stop being polite--and start getting real--in "The Real World: Metropolis." Icons from Star Trek and Tiger Beat alike unite for canned sitcom laughs in "Two Kirks, a Khan and a Pizza Place." Jesus Christ hunts down his greatest nemesis, Tarantino-style, in "Kill Bunny." The hottest game show from Japan is here: "Who Poop Last?" The legends of rock 'n' roll return from beyond the grave to haunt the "Zombie Idol" reality show.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The last surviving member of N*Sync, Joey Fatone, must avenge his murdered bandmates in a deadly martial arts tournament.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The roller-coaster celebrity life of the Incredible Hulk is profiled in "Hollywood Spotlight." The Masters of the Universe are rocked by a Paris Hilton-style sex tape.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: William Shatner's toupee has adventures the action star can only dream of. Heaven's not all it's cracked up to be in "Can We Handle the Truth?" programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: "The World's Most One-Sided Fistfights" get wild at Mardi Gras. Benjamin Franklin grapples with historical figures like the Wright Brothers and Mahatma Gandhi in "Educational Wrestling Federation."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The world's most famous monkey busts loose on Skull Island in "Ding Dong, King Kong." Scandalous Hollywood news and gossip get the Pat O'Brien treatment. The Smurfs are terrorized by a serial killer in "Murder in Smurf Town X."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Sailor Moon encounters a bone-chilling villain. A nerd wins a date with famous actress Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: Michael Knight's talking car parties hard in "KITT's Day Out." A brawl rocks the nursing home in "Grandma Fu." Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen unite to fight a rampaging dragon. George Jetson's murder takes center stage in "Unsolved Case Files: I, Rosie."

programme.title: Robot Chicken
programme.desc: The classic film Jaws gets a special edition DVD. Scandal at the North Pole is revealed in "Unsolved Case Files: Claus & Effect." The A-Team solves its problems with maximum firepower and minimal intelligence.

programme.title: Robot Chicken
